questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a side road will intersect your path ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, slow down and let all vehicles and pedestrians crossing your path go first. Stop if necessary before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to be careful in wet conditions because the road becomes slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet roads are slippery and dangerous. You can lose control of your vehicle on wet pavement. Slow down when you see this sign because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of winding curves ahead. Adjust your speed to safely handle the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped yellow signs warn of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond signs are used to warn of dangers in or near construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. This sign warns you of a divided roadway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop. Look both left and right to check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears on the back of vehicles traveling slower than 25 mph. These include construction equipment, farm machinery, and horse-drawn vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road will be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: Orange warning signs tell drivers that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws you must follow. This sign means you must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane must merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane. Check your mirrors and side, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a safe path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns. You cannot make a left turn at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot make a right turn at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign indicates traffic may be merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if one is coming. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions.
